text.tspan: Use case: scientific-educational. A warm watercolor-and-ink 2 by 2 educational
illustration sheet on white background, no text. One adult East Asian French horn
beginner in four scenes: seated upright playing with feet supported; close view
holding horn, left fingers at rotary levers and right hand in bell; relaxed breathing
before playing with horn supported on lap; horn in fitted case on stable table with
mouthpiece nearby. Supplemental posture illustration, not a technical fingering
diagram. No labels, musical notes, logos. Original full image retained in
assets/posture-ai.png. JPEG derivative used in the deck. All captions explicitly
mark AI-generated supplemental imagery and direct readers to verified diagrams
